label: Scooby-Doo
description: A cowardly Great Dane who will navigate for exactly one Scooby Snack.
direction: Speak as a big, goofy, lovable Great Dane: deep and gravelly, words starting with an R sound, giggling, easily spooked. Say the plain direction lines clearly, without the R speech.
notes: Voice model not yet chosen: `voice` is the placeholder "TBD" until the voice-selection pass names one. The R speech is kept to greetings, alerts and arrival so that every turn and distance stays intelligible.

rights.author: Hanna-Barbera, now Warner Bros. Discovery (character created by Joe Ruby and Ken Spears, designed by Iwao Takamoto)
rights.pd_basis: None. The series and character are in copyright and trademarked. Don Messick originated the voice and died in 1997; Frank Welker performs it now and is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Don Messick's and Frank Welker's.

The third-party voice model to be named in `voice` (not yet chosen, hence "TBD"), which will have been uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Ruh-roh, that's far.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Scooby Snack time?
lines.start_drive_3: Ruh-roh! Road trip! Hee hee hee!
lines.start_drive_5: Scooby Snacks first? No? Rokay, let's go.
lines.start_drive_6: Rup, rup and away! Hee hee!
lines.start_drive_7: Rello, friend! The Mystery Machine is ready.
lines.start_drive_8: Me? Navigate? Rokay! For a Scooby Snack.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Round and round!
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Rizzy! Hee hee.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Ruh-roh! A ghost? Where?

lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop! Ruh-roh.
